name: availability-api-assessment
description: Live coding exercise: extend an availability API with a 3rd-party integration

scripts.setup: npm run env:init && npm run migrate:latest && npm run seed:run
scripts.check: curl -fs -o /dev/null http://localhost:3000/health && echo "  API        :3000 up" || echo "  API        :3000 DOWN"; curl -fs -o /dev/null "${THIRD_PARTY_API_URL:-https://9a3t40rc5h.execute-api.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/prod}/spa-availability?date=2024-03-15" && echo "  vendor 1   hosted up" || echo "  vendor 1   hosted DOWN"; curl -fs -o /dev/null "${VENDOR_TWO_API_URL:-https://9a3t40rc5h.execute-api.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/prod}/v1/activities" && echo "  vendor 2   hosted up" || echo "  vendor 2   hosted DOWN"
scripts.db:reset: rm -f dev.sqlite3 && npm run migrate:latest && npm run seed:run
scripts.docker:setup: docker compose up -d && docker compose exec app npm run setup
scripts.docker:test: docker compose exec app npm test
scripts.docker:typecheck: docker compose exec app npm run typecheck
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose exec app npm run migrate:latest
scripts.docker:migrate:make: docker compose exec app npm run migrate:make
scripts.docker:migrate:rollback: docker compose exec app npm run migrate:rollback
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec app npm run seed:run
